expected_sections: Subject : Guidelines for Engagement of Employees on Contract basis

claim_truth.subject: All Administrative Departments and Heads of Departments

object.value: follow the following terms and conditions while making engagements on contract basis

claim_truth.evidence_quote: All Administrative Departments and Heads of Departments should scrupulously follow the following terms and conditions while making engagements on contract basis

claim_truth.subject: engagement on contract basis

object.value: be made except with prior approval of DP&AR and Finance Department

claim_truth.evidence_quote: No engagement on contract basis shall be made except with prior approval of DP&AR and Finance Department, Government of Mizoram.

claim_truth.subject: Period of engagement on contract basis

object.value: one year at the initial stage

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Period of engagement on contract basis shall be for one year at the initial stage.

claim_truth.subject: Retired Officers
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Retired Officers should not normally be engaged on contract basis beyond attainment of 63 years of age

claim_truth.subject: contract employee

object.value: neither be delegated with financial powers nor assigned the work of DDO

claim_truth.evidence_quote: No engagement on contract basis should be made against such post(s) having financial powers and a contract employee should neither be delegated with financial powers nor assigned the work of DDO

claim_truth.subject: rate of monthly remuneration of contract employee

object.value: minimum scale of pay attached to the post plus 50%

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The rate of monthly remuneration of contract employee shall be equal to the minimum scale of pay attached to the post in which he/she in engaged plus 50% of that amount.

claim_truth.subject: Contract employees

object.value: at par with other regular government servants

claim_truth.evidence_quote: All Contract employees shall be entitled to Medical Re-imbursement at par with other regular government servants.

claim_truth.subject: gratuity

object.value: be permissible if he had completed not less than five years continuous engagement

claim_truth.evidence_quote: gratuity at the rate of one-half of a months remuneration for each completed year of engagement shall be permissible if he had completed not less than five years continuous

claim_truth.subject: Earned leave

object.value: subject to a maximum of 150 days

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Earned leave at his credit subject to a maximum of 150 days shall be encashed.

claim_truth.subject: Service book

object.value: shall be maintained for each contract employee

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Service book shall be maintained for each contract employee.
